verdict.rationale: A is the balanced one-stop, reasonable-connection option, but it is the most expensive and later than C and D. C is cheaper and arrives earlier but adds a second connection. D is cheaper and earliest but has a short ORD connection and less post-audit buffer. B is a cheaper one-stop option with a very long but low-risk layover. Selecting a lead requires an unstated tradeoff among cost, arrival time, connection risk, and tolerance for a 3:15 p.m. departure after the audit.
